newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hogy Medical jumps on earnings in morning.
newsitem.headline: Hogy Medical jumps on earnings in morning.

text.p: Hogy Medical Co jumped in the Wednesday morning session, lifted by its announcement of robust earnings results on Tuesday, brokers said.
As of 0057 GMT the shares were up 140 yen at 3,980 on the second section of the Tokyo bourse.
The producer of disposable surgical gowns said on Tuesday that in the year to March 31, 1997 its parent current profit was 3.72 billion yen, against 3.54 billion the previous year.
Hogy forecast a parent current profit of 3.98 billion for the year to March 31, 1998.
